items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I used to go to this camp, man. I met Governor Patterson.

ctx.x: I've heard of him, but I don't know him.

He's a fine musician. He plays trumpet, vibes, and piano all over the band. We had a broad saying, I see, stupid, who you met at? You remember the night I was talking to Danny Dean, and the broad said, hello, Sal, Gloria, Gloria. We had Gloria, I see. And we were lying to it, but all the mines, Mississippi, no mines, Mississippi, no hills, no hills, no hills, no hills. Oh, this is beautiful, Mississippi, man. We were going up to Selma, you know, and I called. Four guys in this broad, you see. She was the second…
painting, man. Oh. We better call it to a halt, huh? It's finished just about. Well, thank you very much. We should appreciate it, my man. Told us too much. Too much.
